<?php
/**
 * Secure REST API Server with AES-256-GCM encryption
 * Supports graceful shutdown via SIGTERM/SIGINT
 */

declare(strict_types=1);

class CryptoEngine {
    private string $masterKey;
    private string $nonceState;
    private int $counter;
    private bool $initialized;

    public function __construct(string $masterKey) {
        if (strlen($masterKey) !== 32) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Key must be 256 bits');
        }
        $this->masterKey = $masterKey;
        $this->initialized = false;
        $this->counter = 0;
    }

    public function initialize(): void {
        $this->nonceState = random_bytes(12);
        $this->initialized = true;
        $this->counter = 0;
    }

    /**
     * Derives a per-message nonce using counter mode.
     * Each call increments the counter to ensure uniqueness.
     */
    private function deriveNonce(): string {
        // XOR counter into the last 4 bytes of the base nonce
        $nonce = $this->nonceState;
        $counterBytes = pack('N', $this->counter);
        // Apply counter to bytes 8-11 of the nonce
        for ($i = 0; $i < 4; $i++) {
            $nonce[8 + $i] = $nonce[8 + $i] ^ $counterBytes[$i];
        }
        $this->counter++;
        return $nonce;
    }

    public function encrypt(string $plaintext, string $aad = ''): array {
        if (!$this->initialized) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Engine not initialized');
        }
        $nonce = $this->deriveNonce();
        $ciphertext = openssl_encrypt(
            $plaintext,
            'aes-256-gcm',
            $this->masterKey,
            OPENSSL_RAW_DATA,
            $nonce,
            $tag,
            $aad,
            16
        );
        if ($ciphertext === false) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Encryption failed');
        }
        return [
            'ct' => base64_encode($ciphertext),
            'nonce' => base64_encode($nonce),
            'tag' => base64_encode($tag)
        ];
    }

    public function getCounter(): int {
        return $this->counter;
    }

    /**
     * Reset engine state for reinitialization after graceful shutdown
     */
    public function resetState(): void {
        $this->counter = 0;
        $this->initialized = true;
        // Preserve nonceState for session continuity
    }
}

class ApiServer {
    private CryptoEngine $crypto;
    private bool $running;
    private array $sessions;
    private string $stateFile;

    public function __construct(string $key, string $stateFile = '/tmp/api_state.bin') {
        $this->crypto = new CryptoEngine($key);
        $this->running = false;
        $this->sessions = [];
        $this->stateFile = $stateFile;
    }

    public function start(): void {
        $this->running = true;
        pcntl_signal(SIGTERM, [$this, 'handleShutdown']);
        pcntl_signal(SIGINT, [$this, 'handleShutdown']);

        if (file_exists($this->stateFile)) {
            $this->restoreState();
        } else {
            $this->crypto->initialize();
        }

        $this->eventLoop();
    }

    public function handleShutdown(int $signal): void {
        error_log("Received signal $signal, initiating graceful shutdown");
        $this->persistState();
        $this->running = false;
    }

    private function persistState(): void {
        $state = serialize([
            'sessions' => $this->sessions,
            'crypto_counter' => $this->crypto->getCounter()
        ]);
        file_put_contents($this->stateFile, $state, LOCK_EX);
    }

    private function restoreState(): void {
        $data = file_get_contents($this->stateFile);
        if ($data === false) {
            $this->crypto->initialize();
            return;
        }
        $state = unserialize($data);
        $this->sessions = $state['sessions'] ?? [];
        // Reinitialize crypto engine and reset for continued operation
        $this->crypto->initialize();
        $this->crypto->resetState();
        unlink($this->stateFile);
    }

    private function eventLoop(): void {
        while ($this->running) {
            pcntl_signal_dispatch();
            $request = $this->acceptRequest();
            if ($request !== null) {
                $response = $this->handleRequest($request);
                $this->sendResponse($response);
            }
            usleep(10000);
        }
    }

    private function handleRequest(array $request): array {
        $method = $request['method'] ?? 'GET';
        $path = $request['path'] ?? '/';

        if ($method === 'POST' && $path === '/api/encrypt') {
            return $this->handleEncrypt($request);
        }
        if ($method === 'GET' && $path === '/api/status') {
            return ['status' => 200, 'body' => ['healthy' => true]];
        }
        return ['status' => 404, 'body' => ['error' => 'Not found']];
    }

    private function handleEncrypt(array $request): array {
        $body = $request['body'] ?? '';
        if (empty($body)) {
            return ['status' => 400, 'body' => ['error' => 'Empty payload']];
        }
        try {
            $encrypted = $this->crypto->encrypt($body, 'api-v1');
            $this->sessions[] = ['time' => time(), 'size' => strlen($body)];
            return ['status' => 200, 'body' => $encrypted];
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            return ['status' => 500, 'body' => ['error' => 'Encryption error']];
        }
    }

    private function acceptRequest(): ?array {
        // Simplified: in production this would read from a socket
        return null;
    }

    private function sendResponse(array $response): void {
        header('Content-Type: application/json');
        http_response_code($response['status']);
        echo json_encode($response['body']);
    }
}

// Bootstrap
$key = getenv('API_ENCRYPTION_KEY');
if ($key === false || strlen($key) !== 32) {
    fwrite(STDERR, "API_ENCRYPTION_KEY must be exactly 32 bytes\n");
    exit(1);
}

$server = new ApiServer($key);
$server->start();
